quests.title: Peculiar Wonderland

dialogue.t: Welcome! Did you come here to challenge the domain in front of your very eyes?

dialogue.sit: I wouldn't say no to that.

dialogue.t: You've found the right guy, then. Allow me to introduce it to you. I'm Plauen of the Adventurers' Guild, in charge of securing the entrance to this domain.
According to our records, it seems to only appear at specific times.
It's the Windblume Festival at the moment, so we made a few modifications to the interior to turn it into a unique challenge before opening it to the public.
Not to worry. This is a special event organized to celebrate this festival. We'll have seasoned adventurers accompanying anyone who doesn't have any adventuring experience.
I doubt that you'll need any help on that front, though, veteran that you are.
You can explore this Domain alone or invite some friends to come along. Either way, you'll receive a reward if you can make it to the end.

dialogue.sit: Will do — so long as there's a reward.

dialogue.t: Then I shan't delay you any longer. Have fun in there!

quests.description: Plauen of the Adventurers’ Guild would like to introduce you to a mysterious Domain in the wilds of Mondstadt.
